newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Seven sees double digit sales rise.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Seven sees double digit sales rise.

text.p: Television operator Seven Network Ltd was expected to achieve double digit sales revenue growth in the year to June 30, 1997, Seven managing director Gary Rice said on Wednesday.
"I think we'll go close to that (to double digit sales growth)," Rice said told reporters after a Securities Institute of Australia presentation here.
Seven, which is 20 percent owned by its chairman Kerry Stokes, reported a 15.2 percent rise in sales to A$671.15 million in 1995/96.
Rice noted the advertising market had slowed since April.
"That's put a bit of a dampener on things for everybody," he said.
But he added that the sector was likely to improve in early 1997.
"At the start of next year there are certainly some reasonable signs of improvement predicted," Rice said.
He did not elaborate on what factors would underpin the improvement in the advertising market.
Seven, which is also 15 percent owned by Rupert Murdoch's News Corp Ltd, reported a jump in net profit to A$115.13 million in the year to June 30 from A$41.26 million in 1994/95.
The previous result was hit by an advertising rate bungle.
At 0524 GMT Seven shares were up three cents to A$3.70.
